description_en: Adds a video, audio, or image to a specified search library, and supports configuring the media asset ID, basic information, and business group. The returned media asset ID can be used to query indexing tasks or perform subsequent operations on the media asset
description_zh: 将视频、音频或图片加入指定搜索库，支持设置媒资标识、基础信息和业务分组。返回的媒资 ID 可用于查询索引任务或执行后续媒资操作
name: InsertMediaToSearchLib

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library. You must call the CreateSearchLib operation to create the search library in advance
parameters.help_zh: 搜索库名称。需要调用CreateSearchLib接口提前建立好搜索库
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset. The ID must be unique. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates an ID
parameters.help_zh: 媒资ID。具有唯一性，不填会自动生成
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the media asset. Default value: video. Valid values:
video: Video.
image: Image.
audio: Audio
parameters.help_zh:
媒资类型。默认值video。
video视频
image图片
audio音频
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the video, audio, or image file to be added to the library. Do not use temporary URLs, and ensure that the source file is accessible.

Ensure that the file name is correct and the bucket is in the same region where the API is called. Otherwise, the file may not be found or the API call may fail.
OSS URL (recommended): oss://[bucket name]/[file path], such as oss://[example-bucket-****]/[object_path-****].
HTTP URL: a publicly downloadable URL, such as http://example-test-****.mp4
parameters.help_zh:
需要入库的视频、音频或图片文件的地址，请勿使用临时地址，需保证源文件可以被访问。

请确认您的文件名正确且所在Bucket与接口调用地域一致，否则可能导致找不到文件或接口调用失败。
OSS地址（推荐）：oss://[Bucket名称]/[文件路径]，例如oss://[example-bucket-****]/[object_path-****]。
HTTP地址：公网可下载的地址，例如http://example-test-****.mp4
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en:
The information about the media asset. The value is a JSON string. Supported fields:
title: the title, of the String type.
customFields: the custom fields, of the JSONObject type. This parameter cannot be modified. Supported sub-fields include intField1 of the Integer type, and strField1 and strField2 of the String type
parameters.help_zh:
媒资信息。JSON字符串。支持字段：
title，标题，string类型
customFields，自定义字段，JSONObject，参数不支持修改；支持Int型intField1、string型strField1、strField2
parameters.name: msg_body

parameters.help_en: The information about the image set. This parameter is supported only in IP camera scenarios. The MediaType parameter must be set to video
parameters.help_zh: 图片集信息。仅支持IPCamera场景，MediaType需为video
parameters.name: images_input

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
true： 成功
false：失败
